question: Can the Korean government's Customs Service press-release list identify one dated original 1-20-day import/export release page in each month of 2018-2022, before attempting semiconductor numeric extraction or any Stage1 feature fit?
discovery_evidence: Before this plan, exact official portal list queries found October anchors for 2018-2025 and a January 2018, February 2019 and December 2022 example. These are source discovery only, not 60-month coverage proof or first-public receipts.

query_contract.months: every calendar month 2018-01 through 2022-12 inclusive, exactly 60
query_contract.parameters: startDate=YYYY-MM-20, endDate=YYYY-MM-27, srchWord=수출입, repCode=B00003, pageIndex=1 in this order via urllib.parse.urlencode
query_contract.identity_rule: Within each returned official HTML list, accept exactly one href containing pressReleaseView.do and newsId whose visible title/snippet contains the queried month, 1일, 20일, 수출입 현황 and 관세청; preserve 0/multiple as unknown and every candidate. Never substitute a newspaper result or infer a number from the list.

source_artifacts: Store exact response bodies, response headers, request URLs, start/end UTC, HTTP status, SHA256 and byte counts in data/snapshots/kcs_early20_2018_2022_portal_index_20261023; archive all original bytes to Yanxuan NAS with remote hash and scoped cold restore. Keep small monthly status and complete query receipts in a native Qlib Recorder.
stop: Missing, ambiguous, oversized, non-200, non-HTML or timed-out months stay unknown. Do not search alternative wording/pages, fetch attachments, use current values as original vintages, build a factor, fit or run an account in this fixed index version. A separate bounded repair is needed for gaps, and full original attachments plus timing must be qualified before a Stage1 feature.
